flow_ref: User story (not in any OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: ocmsadminui: pages/Dashboard/Dashboard.tsx (empty), utils/data/LinkData.tsx (LinkWorkItem commented out), utils/Meta/WorkItem.ts, utils/validation/Dashboard.ts (ValidSearchWorkItem unused), context/AuthContext.tsx, pages/NoticeUPL (UPL endorse, calls approvalinbox/workitem). ocmsadminapi: auth/interceptor/OcmsAuthorizationInterceptor + api-authorization.properties (authorization per function ID), workflows/furnish/dashboard/FurnishDashboardController (furnish application list, not wired to the UI). No work item controller/entity in ocmsadminapi or ocmsadminprivateapi.
note: The story asks for a supervisor to see the outstanding work items of all users with a filter. There is no work item feature in the code: the staff portal Dashboard is empty, the Work Items menu (LinkWorkItem) is commented out and has no Route, and there is no work item endpoint, entity or table in the backend (grep approvalinbox, supervis, endorse: 0 hits; the words work item appear only as the name of an HST statistics report in the cron, HstReportHelper.java:511,575). Only generic authorization per function ID and an unused ValidSearchWorkItem exist. The Built - Has gap status in the sheet is not supported by the code for the core steps. No relevant maintenance ticket. Role/function assignment in ACM: cannot verify from repo.
recommendation: Do not claim as done. Only the generic authorization per function ID can be reused. The work item list, supervisory rights and filter are not in the repo; ask URA/the team whether it is built in another repo or mark it as a gap.

steps.step: The officer has supervisory access rights in OCMS
steps.detail: Staff portal access is controlled per function ID from the ACM JWT: the UI uses hasFunction(functionId) (AuthContext.tsx:79-84) and the server answers 403 when the request path is not in the user's function mapping (OcmsAuthorizationInterceptor.java:51-72, registered in WebConfig.java:79-90). But grep supervis (case-insensitive) in ocmsadminui, ocmsadminapi and ocmsadminprivateapi: 0 hits. There is no function ID, role or supervisor check, and no work item endpoint mapping in api-authorization.properties. The generic access mechanism exists, a dedicated supervisory right does not. Role assignment in ACM: cannot verify from repo.

steps.step: The OCMS dashboard/menu has a place to see outstanding work items
steps.detail: The Dashboard component only renders a DataForm with an empty div (Dashboard.tsx:17-31), no work item widget. LinkWorkItem (path /work-item) is defined (LinkData.tsx:170-173) but menu.push(LinkWorkItem) is commented out under the UNCONFIRMED block (LinkData.tsx:397-398), and App.tsx has no Route for /work-item (path /* falls to Dashboard, App.tsx:79-81). WorkItem.ts:1-12 holds only path and title constants; the only other user of MetaWorkItem is the HST page breadcrumb (pages/HST/HST.tsx:30).

steps.step: OCMS shows the outstanding work items of all users
steps.detail: There is no work item controller, entity or repository in ocmsadminapi or ocmsadminprivateapi (grep approvalinbox and supervis in backend src: 0 hits; the words work item in the backend are only the name of an HST statistics report in the cron, HstReportHelper.java:511,575, not a work item feature). workitem, workitemallocation and workitemnotices are only resource names in a TypeScript type (Fapi.d.ts:264-266); the UPL UI calls approvalinbox only when isAPIFound (STAGING/LOCAL, utils/config/env.ts:11) and shows The API is not yet prepared (useEndorsement.tsx:100). The closest code is POST /v1/furnish/officer/list (FurnishDashboardController.java:18-37): a furnish application list by status, but one item type only, not per user/assignee, not called from any UI, and the prefix /v1/furnish/officer is absent from api-authorization.properties so the interceptor answers 403. Not claimed.

steps.step: The officer can filter the work items shown
steps.detail: Only ValidSearchWorkItem() exists with process_type, title, status (all optional, Dashboard.ts:11-19), and grep shows the function is not used anywhere. There is no filter form, grid or query parameter for work items.
